name: Alumni outreach
description: Reconnects with someone who shares your school or former employer, using the shared background as a natural reason to start a conversation.
audience: People who attended the same school or worked at the same former employer.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — noticed we both spent time at {{school|the same school}}. Always nice to connect with someone from the same community.
Hi {{firstName|there}}, saw that we both worked at {{company|the same former company}}. Thought it would be good to connect.
Thanks for connecting, {{firstName|there}}. I'm always curious where people from {{school|our shared background}} end up. What's keeping you busy these days?
Appreciate the connect, {{firstName|there}}. It's good to see where people from {{company|our former company}} have gone. What are you working on now?
Would be glad to compare notes sometime, {{firstName|there}}. Always interesting to hear how someone's path has developed since {{school|school}}.
I'll leave you to it, {{firstName|there}}. If you're ever up for a quick catch-up about {{company|our old workplace}}, happy to chat.
